what_it_measured.text: Thymosin β4: A ubiquitous peptide in rat and mouse tissues

endpoint.text: We now report that this peptide is present in a variety of rat and mouse tissues, including macrophages. Its concentration is elevated in tissues from athymic (nu/nu) mice.
